test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As of April 2022, which of the following features of citizenship given in the Constitution of India is NOT true?

options.text: The Constitution of India provides for single citizenship.
The UK Constitution inspired this notion of citizenship.
People can benefit from the development of advantages merely by becoming citizens.
The ability to vote and be elected to positions such as President and Member of Parliament is accessible to Indians around the world.

solution:
The correct answer is __**the ability to vote and be elected to positions such as President and Member of Parliament is accessible to Indian around the world.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Constitution established a system of single citizenship and provided uniform rights (except in a few cases) to the people of India in order to foster a sense of fraternity and unity among them and to build an integrated Indian nation.
 
• In India, the concept of single citizenship is adopted from the British constitution that is from the united kingdom. In India, only single citizenship is available to citizens. One cannot be a citizen of the state as well. 
 
• The term citizenship entails the enjoyment of full membership in any State in which a citizen has civil and political rights. People can benefit from the development of advantages merely by becoming citizens.
 
• An only Indian citizens can become the President and Member of Parliament.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__** 

 
• **Citizenship:**

 
 
• ​It comes under **Articles 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10, and 11 of Part II of the Indian Constitution.**
 
• Citizenship Act 1955

• **Citizenship by descent**
 
• **Citizenship by registration**
